selected_white_space.thesis: Make community retention and anti-displacement a release gate for every AI innovation and urban-renewal project.
selected_white_space.difference_from_existing_mentions: Several peers mention affordability, original residents, rent, or gentrification as one risk or KPI. Rooted Jing-Zhang makes the evidence contract, retention stress test, shop continuity, essential-worker access, and no-automated-displacement rule the organizing spatial and operating system.
